sources.label: ATRS board packet
sources.normalizedEvidenceText: Arkansas Teacher Retirement System board packet dated 2023-09-25, EnCap Energy Transition Fund II, L.P. investment summary page 524: EETF II had committed to five portfolio companies. Bleutec Industries commitment date Dec-22, commitment amount $68.7 million, invested capital $5.5 million, description “Develop and operate offshore wind turbine and pile installation vessels.” All five companies were still in early start-up phase with funded costs used primarily to cover expense overhead.
sources.note: The direct public-fiduciary packet resolves the exact historical fund, December 2022 commitment date, $68.7 million commitment and $5.5 million invested capital. It does not establish legal close, exact stake or control, cutoff-current ownership, delivered vessels or current operations. The general Fund II control strategy is not converted into exact Bleutec control.

sources.label: EnCap commitment
sources.note: The direct manager release identifies Bleutec Industries LLC, Houston, a 2019 founding and a 2022-11-30 EnCap equity commitment with management investing alongside. It does not disclose the fund, vehicle, stake, control or legal close.

sources.label: Bleutec FWS deck
sources.note: Rendered page 2 directly identifies Bleutec Industries Offshore Wind Services LLC, a 2019 founding and full capitalization with EnCap while describing circa-2026 vessel deployment as a plan, not delivery or operation.

sources.label: PPHB Bleutec
sources.note: The direct adviser page names Bleutec Industries Holding Ltd. Co and an equity capital raise. Its early-2026 deployment language is a forecast and does not establish an operating fleet or the legal relationship among Bleutec entities.

sources.label: NETSCo AiP
sources.note: The direct technical-counterparty page says Bleutec Industries Offshore Wind Services LLC received ABS design Approval in Principle. It does not establish a shipbuilding contract, construction, delivery or operation.

sources.label: MarineLog Title XI
sources.note: The direct trade-press URL was freshly reopened, but the browser returned Cloudflare error 526 and raw HTTP returned 403. Search-index text corroborates the 2023 application figures, but the article body was not independently readable and is not relied upon for the terminal decision.

sources.label: MARAD approvals
sources.note: The direct government page was independently readable in the browser. It lists FY2023 ECO Edison, FY2022 Canal Barge and FY2020 Matson and was last updated 2024-08-07; Bleutec is absent. The stale page and omission do not prove rejection, withdrawal, lapse or any cutoff disposition.

sources.label: EnCap portfolio
sources.note: Bleutec is omitted from the displayed current and realized portfolio. EnCap's separately reopened Energy Transition overview reports 16 investments while this display shows only 10 companies, so the omission is non-dispositive and cannot establish an exit.

additionalCorroboration.label: EnCap Energy Transition overview
additionalCorroboration.finding: The direct manager overview reports 16 portfolio investments and five material monetizations, confirming that the displayed portfolio is incomplete and that Bleutec's omission is non-dispositive.

additionalCorroboration.label: Former Bleutec domain
additionalCorroboration.finding: The former company domain redirects to unrelated content. This is a dormancy signal only and not evidence of sale, dissolution, write-off or ownership exit.

modelHealthOverrides: The initial ChatGPT answer incorrectly left the exact EnCap fund unresolved. Independent direct-source reopening found the ATRS public board packet, and one same-conversation repair produced the accepted packet with EnCap Energy Transition Fund II.

The ATRS packet is a September 2023 historical fund report. It does not establish cutoff-current ownership, a legal close, exact Bleutec stake or control, current management co-investment, vessel delivery or current operations.
The MarineLog article body was not independently readable during this attempt, so its figures are not relied upon for the DEFERRED outcome.
Neither EnCap portfolio omission, a compromised website, management movement, nor silence is converted into an exit, dissolution or realization.
conclusion: Keep Bleutec deferred without a database or seed mutation. The exact historical fund and capital record are now resolved, but cutoff ownership, legal entity chain and status, the Title XI disposition and current operations remain materially unavailable.
